title: Colony PCR Protocol
author: Zhujun Wei
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bnwrmfd6

steps.title: Pick colonies for PCR
steps.instruction: Select colonies to serve as template for colony PCR; choose the number of colonies per plate based on the difference between positive and negative controls and fill the remaining wells with water.

substeps.instruction: Pick colonies as template for colony PCR.
Determine number of colonies per plate according to positive/negative control difference.

steps.title: Test digest and gel analysis
steps.instruction: Perform a test restriction digest on the PCR products and analyze the digest by agarose gel electrophoresis to confirm that the correct construct is present.

substeps.instruction: Perform test digest on PCR products.
Run agarose gel electrophoresis to analyze digest products.

steps.title: Enlarge colonies and mini‑prep
steps.instruction: Use colony PCR to increase the number of colonies, then mini‑prep only those clones that test positive.

substeps.instruction: Use colony PCR to enlarge colony numbers.
